$schema_description: Apache Iceberg feature-by-engine support matrix. Parseable companion to report.md. Generated 2026-06-26 by the deep-research harness.
method: deep-research harness: 25 sources fetched, 120 claims extracted, 25 adversarially verified (23 confirmed).

cell_status.w_partial: write supported but partial (e.g. INSERT only, no UPDATE/DELETE/MERGE)
cell_status.unknown: not confirmed by sources in this run

confidence.source: extracted from a fetched source, not independently re-verified

v1.summary: Management of large analytic tables over immutable files (Parquet/Avro/ORC).

v2.summary: Adds row-level updates and deletes for immutable files (merge-on-read foundation).

features.name: position deletes
features.desc: delete by data file path + row position

features.name: equality deletes
features.desc: delete by column values, e.g. id=5

v3.summary: Extends types and metadata; deliberately aligned with Delta for interop.

features.name: binary deletion vectors
features.risk: high - default-on in all v3 tables; non-DV-aware reader returns deleted rows

features.name: VARIANT
features.desc: semi-structured; shares single binary encoding with Delta variantType (Apache Parquet ratified)

v3.default_on_note: All Apache Iceberg v3 tables include deletion vectors by default.

compatibility.rule: Backward compatible: v1 files remain valid after upgrade to v2. Readers kept permissive; writers must follow stricter version-specific requirements.

libraries.note: Iceberg engine support flows through these libraries (the analog of Delta Kernel). Per-library feature coverage not independently verified in this run.

spark.notes: Reference-grade. v3 deletion vectors and row lineage stable. VARIANT supported (without shredding in Databricks SQL).

flink.notes: Continuous streaming reads and writes plus batch. v3 DV/row-lineage stable.

trino_oss.notes: INSERT / CREATE TABLE AS SELECT; reads+writes. No streaming ingestion. Does not yet support v3 spec.

duckdb_iceberg.notes: Read-only, batch-oriented. Can only read copy-on-write tables WITHOUT delete files (no position deletes, equality deletes, or merge-on-read).

clickhouse.format_version_support: v1/v2 read; v3 NOT supported (rejects DV tables)
clickhouse.notes: Read-only; no write/compaction (scheduled Q3 2025). Rejects v3 deletion-vector tables.

snowflake.notes: Primarily read-oriented via external tables; time travel unavailable for external tables. Iceberg-only (consumes Delta only via UniForm-as-Iceberg).

bigquery.notes: Read queries via external/BigLake tables; time travel unavailable in external tables.

athena.format_version_support: v1/v2; v3 NOT supported (no DV / row lineage / VARIANT)
athena.notes: Read+write at v2; lacks v3 entirely.

impala.notes: Partial write/DML: supports position deletes but NOT equality deletes.

databricks_uniform.format_version_support: targets Iceberg spec v2 only (no v3 via this path)
databricks_uniform.notes: Exposes UniForm-enabled Delta tables to Iceberg clients as read-only. NOTE: distinct from UC managed-Iceberg v3 GA path, which IS v3.

polars.notes: Iceberg support exists via libraries; coverage not confirmed in this run.

datafusion.notes: Consumes Iceberg via iceberg-rust; coverage not confirmed in this run.

daft.notes: Coverage not confirmed in this run.

v3_engine_summary.verdict: As of late 2025/early 2026, Iceberg v3 is NOT production-ready for most orgs because major engines (Athena, OSS Trino, Snowflake) lack v3. v3 DV + row lineage stable only in Spark/Flink; VARIANT only partial; geospatial types unavailable in most engines.

managed_databricks.managed_iceberg_tables: read + write from Iceberg clients (plus optimize/govern/share, Predictive Optimization, Liquid Clustering)
managed_databricks.v3: Iceberg v3 GA on UC (deletion vectors, row tracking, VARIANT across managed/foreign/UniForm)

oss_unitycatalog_io.iceberg: implements Iceberg REST Catalog API (built leveraging Tabular expertise); Iceberg via UniForm
oss_unitycatalog_io.caveat: OSS-UC managed-Iceberg write / v3 parity NOT confirmed; treat as UniForm/read-oriented pending direct confirmation.

uniform.mechanism: auto-generates Iceberg metadata alongside DeltaLog, colocated with Parquet; single copy of data

xtable.mechanism: metadata-only translation; no data file rewrite; ASF incubating

iceberg_to_delta.mechanism: UniForm supports one-time zero-copy in-place conversion of Iceberg tables to Delta

delta_iceberg_alignment.variant_encoding: single shared binary encoding (Apache Parquet ratified)
delta_iceberg_alignment.deletion_vector_encoding: NOT shared - claim refuted in verification (see refuted_claims)

refuted_claims.claim: Iceberg v3 deletion vectors use the same binary encoding as Delta Lake deletion vectors, enabling cross-format DV compatibility.
refuted_claims.note: Do NOT assert binary-level DV interop between the formats. VARIANT does share encoding; DVs do not.

refuted_claims.claim: Iceberg v3 replaces v2 positional/equality deletes with deletion vectors, requiring a single DV per file at write time.
refuted_claims.note: v3 ADDS binary DVs but does not wholesale replace v2 delete files as described.

caveats: Iceberg engine cells are coarser than Delta cells (the verified core under-covered Iceberg engines). All v3 cells are time-sensitive (GA rollout in progress 2025-2026). Confidence 'source' = single source, not adversarially re-verified.
